purpose: Original composition behavior presets. Do not transcribe or reproduce distinctive copyrighted melodies, lyrics, or recordings.

drums_solo_abysmal.core: Bright guitar figures with privately sad harmony, crisp post-punk momentum, bass that sings between vocal lines; experimental details are interruptions, not wallpaper.

drums_solo_brutalism.core: Snappy electronically inflected percussion, clipped guitar/synth counterlines, urgent melodic bass, deceptively happy surfaces with darker borrowed chord color.

drums_solo_jonny.core: Guitar/bass-led emotional economy, bright nervous momentum, intimate repeated motifs, reduced synthetic ornament and contrast through omission.

memory_haze.core: Common tones, suspended endings, slow harmonic breathing, warmth with small wrong notes, imperfect memory repetitions.

lcd_motor.core: Rigid hypnotic pulse, additive entrances, earned lift, minimal ostinati that shift through context rather than complexity.

idm_asymmetric.core: Phrase-cell variations, 3+3+2 accents, rare half-bar displacements, controlled organized breaks while an anchor remains.

garage_interlock.core: Economical contrasting two-part hooks, clipped note lengths, rhythmic handoffs, clean articulated register separation.

yl_tender_nocturne.reference: Yo La Tengo — And Then Nothing Turned Itself Inside-Out / Summer Sun, quiet nocturnal mode
yl_tender_nocturne.core: Softly interlocking guitar/organ/piano tones, restrained bass motion, slow intimate rhythmic breathing, simple tender motifs, suspended harmony, and silence; quiet music with unresolved emotional undertow.
composition_rules: Use two- or three-chord nonfunctional cycles with small voice-leading shifts
Keep lead phrases short and allow whole-bar gaps
Bass supports tender counter-motion rather than constant roots
Contrast comes from note length and silence, not more layers
Sparse brushes/soft backbeat with human-sounding velocities
avoid: mistaking lo-fi for missing musical detail

yl_motorik_fuzz.reference: Yo La Tengo — I Can Hear the Heart Beating as One / This Stupid World motorik rock
yl_motorik_fuzz.core: Unwavering live-band pulse, melodic repetitive bass, economical guitar figures, small modal chord loops and guitar noise that accumulates over time without losing the groove.
composition_rules: One compelling 1–2 bar bass motif anchors whole sections
8–16 bar repetitions evolve through one changed voice at a time
Drums maintain understated snare/kick stability
Fuzz/noise represented as sustained pedal notes and clustered guitar-register phrases; tone requires external plugins
Use imperfect live phrasing, avoid big EDM drops

yl_kaleidoscope_pop.reference: Yo La Tengo — I Can Hear the Heart Beating as One melodic indie-pop spectrum
yl_kaleidoscope_pop.core: Warm modest melodies, elastic guitar/bass interplay, gentle organ coloration, mostly simple chords with one memorable lifted or borrowed tone, playfulness beside yearning.
composition_rules: Preserve concise singable melodic cells rather than nonstop notes
Introduce a counter-guitar only in gaps of the main melody
Use chord inversions and sustained common tones
Alternate fragile verse with surprisingly buoyant refrain

yl_drone_feedback.reference: Yo La Tengo — Painful / This Stupid World extended drone/noise and slow transformation
yl_drone_feedback.core: Patient bass ostinati, held modal centers, friction between gentle repeated figures and abrasive harmonic clusters, imperfect transitions and long-form tension.
composition_rules: Create 1–3 note tonal anchors and deliberately retain them
Add upper-neighbor clusters in sparse registers for dissonance
Allow 16+ bars without chord changes if other events evolve
Distortion/feedback cannot be literally stored in MIDI: assign sustained notes to external guitar effects or synths
Reintroduce original clean motif after dense noise
avoid: random notes used as a substitute for feedback

pink_bedroom_2step.reference: Early compact garage-pop / wistful bedroom two-step
pink_bedroom_2step.core: Wistful airy short motifs; swung kick placement and broken 2-step snare, delicate R&B keyboard voicings, small edits and short melodic bass punctuations.
avoid: avoid four-on-the-floor for the entire composition

musical_guidance.harmony: Use evolving soft-color piano/organ voicings; allow bittersweet modal shifts and gentle chromatic voice leading.
musical_guidance.rhythm: Favor shuffled/offset two-step snare, shuffled hats, kick omission and syncopated percussion; for liquid jungle use rolling break cells.
musical_guidance.bass: Warm rounded sub and octave/anticipation gestures; keep the bassline independent.
musical_guidance.melody: Four-to-six note original motifs, intimate vocal range and contour, repeated with one altered ending.
musical_guidance.arrangement: Compact form, frequent subtractive transitions and significant vocal-space; keep loop identity.

pink_liquid_jungle.reference: Liquid DnB and melodic jungle-pop crossover
pink_liquid_jungle.core: Rolling breakbeat-inspired rhythms, fast but feather-light motifs, nimble sub-bass movement, short bright melodic fragments and soft major-minor ambiguity.
avoid: faster break logic may require additional MIDI drum arranging
keep bass rhythm distinct from snare

avoid: keep melodic contour short and personal
do not saturate the vocal range

avoid: leave at least one silent pocket per phrase

parttime_lies_eyes_love.reference: Part Time - Lies in the Eyes of Love (2019) songwriting and timbral traits
parttime_lies_eyes_love.core: Hypnotic rippling synth ostinato, melancholy yet warmly danceable new-wave pulse, compact repeated hook, dry economical drum-machine and an occasional odd accent or outro countermelody.
avoid: transcribing the actual song hook or progression

parttime_casio_bedroom.reference: Part Time - What Would You Say? / PDA early bedroom recordings
parttime_casio_bedroom.core: Primitive keyboard ostinati, wonky human feel, bright but slightly creepy chord movement, steady inexpensive drum-machine feel, loose guitar coloration and concise strange hooks.
avoid: random wrong notes mistaken for character

parttime_afterhours_softrock.reference: Part Time - Spell #6 and hazy psychedelic soft-rock sides
parttime_afterhours_softrock.core: Slow-burn soft-rock harmony, romantic electric-piano and chorus-guitar exchanges, singing bass and subtly wrong turns in a warm, softly surreal bedroom arrangement.

parttime_neon_motor.reference: Part Time - nocturnal new-wave / synth-disco traits
parttime_neon_motor.core: Bouncing mono synth bass, short melodic stabs, locked vintage machine pulse, odd but catchy synthetic fill-ins and extended hypnotic movement.

no_movement_cold.reference: New Order - Movement (1981), early post-punk transition
no_movement_cold.core: Cold post-punk austerity: dark repeating minor/ambiguous chords, spare distorted guitar fragments, tense high-register melodic bass, tight live-feel drums, synths as atmospheric interruptions.
composition_rules: Bass should be an independent upper-register melodic line; avoid sustained sub-bass unless separately assigned.
Use close two- and three-note voicings, pedal tones and ambiguous suspended color.
Short repeating guitar figures, imperfect player timing, restrained percussion.
Silence and starkness matter more than dense keyboards.
avoid: copying Ceremony, Dreams Never End or original New Order motifs
droning on a single pitch for minutes without development

no_pcl_sunrise.reference: New Order - Power Corruption & Lies (1983); early bright post-punk/synth fusion
no_pcl_sunrise.core: Melodic picked bass high in register, chiming economical guitar, primitive synth strings, snappy motoric hats and irresistible bittersweet harmonic lift.
composition_rules: Lead-like bass melody answers rather than doubles vocal guide.
Bass movement carries emotional hook; guitar works in repetitive upper cells.
Favor slowly rotating major/minor ambiguity and suspended resolutions.
Leave a guitar/bass-only passage somewhere in the arrangement.
avoid: copying Age of Consent, Temptation or Leave Me Alone basslines

no_lowlife_machine_romance.core: Dense but legible sequenced synth and electro-drums underneath a distinct melodic picked bass, bright melancholy lead, and tightly grouped guitar accents.
composition_rules: Let a repetitive low synth-bass ostinato support a separate melodic bass line.
Mechanical drum grid with occasional machine fills; bass performer remains elastic.
Extended transitions and periodic instrumental breathing room.
Reharmonization should not obscure the recognizable topline.
avoid: recreating Blue Monday or The Perfect Kiss drum sequences
busy chord comps colliding with both basses

no_brotherhood_interlock.core: Interlocking ringing guitar notes, direct melodic bass, propulsive live-like drums, and occasional pure dance-synth counterweight; bittersweet pop melodic arc.
composition_rules: Two guitar-register MIDI roles should interlock rhythmically rather than double.
Use upper-register bass to create moving parallel or contrary countermelody.
A chorus can feel wide without adding more instruments.
Use occasional drastic texture switches between band and machines.
avoid: flattening the guitars into repeated quarter-note chords

no_technique_balearic.reference: New Order - Technique (1989), Ibiza/Balearic dance-rock chemistry
no_technique_balearic.core: Balearic/dance pulse, rolling syncopated house/acid-influenced synth bass, chime-like guitar hooks, organic melodic picked bass and wistful neon-pop chord colors.
composition_rules: Use a programmed low bass separate from freer upper melodic picked bass.
Syncopated stabs and pulsing dance percussion; irregular tiny changes rather than giant EDM drops.
Guitar can enter late as a human counterpoint to already-established machines.
Song should feel sunlit and sad, with shifting instrumental verses or interludes.
avoid: copying Fine Time, Round & Round or specific acid basslines

no_republic_afterglow.reference: New Order - Republic (1993), warm polished melancholic synth-dance
no_republic_afterglow.core: Warm glossy chords, simple emotionally direct hook, fluent bass countermelody and smooth steady club drums, bittersweet end-of-night feeling.
composition_rules: Prefer voice-led warm harmonic loops and understated major/minor interchange.
Let melody return in altered voicing on final refrain.
Use broad synth pads without crowding vocal space.
Gentle drum machine with later lift, not an EDM drop.
avoid: copying Regret, World or other identifiable themes
overly glossy synth walls with no bass independence

no_hook_bass_personality.reference: New Order/Peter Hook melodic picked upper-register bass - abstract performance and arrangement profile
no_hook_bass_personality.core: Bass guitar acts as a memorable melodic voice high above a low pedal or separate synth sub; pick articulation, short connective pickups, repeating contour, chorus-ready movement.
composition_rules: Write register A2-E4 depending on instrument and chord voicings; allow rare higher peaks.
Double bass roles only if low synth bass occupies independent register; use high bass as counter-melody.
Use clear pick-attack accents, mild microtiming deviation and deliberate rests.
Steer clear of exact famous lines, shapes and quote-like melodies.
avoid: harmonically unrelated leaps to sound technical
